fullPassage: We might not think of ourselves as global citizens yet, but it's both necessary and possible to do so. Some people are skeptical about the idea of global citizenship, but for most of human history, people didn't think of themselves as citizens of nation-states. After all, for most of human history, nation-states didn't exist. The rise of nation-states over the last few centuries has led people to add state citizenship to other identities, such as family, people group, or religion. Given the connections between people around the world and the common challenges we face, we need to layer global citizenship on to these other identities. This doesn't mean that global citizenship replaces these other identities. There's not a single story about our identities. Instead, it's precisely because we have obligations to our families, those in our community, and those around the world.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: be동사 are 뒤 보어 자리에는 형용사가 필요. skeptic(명사: 회의론자) → skeptical(형용사: 회의적인). -al 접미사
det.tip: skeptic(명사) → skeptical(형용사). be + 형용사 보어

questions.passage: We might not think of ourselves as global citizens yet, but it's both necessary and possible to do so. Some people are skeptical about the idea of global citizenship, but for most of human history, people didn't think of themselves as citizens of nation-states. After all, for most of human history, nation-states didn't exist. The rise of nation-states over the last few centuries has led people to add __________ to other identities, such as family, people group, or religion. Given the connections between people around the world and the common challenges we face, we need to layer global citizenship on to these other identities. This doesn't mean that global citizenship replaces these other identities. There's not a single story about our identities. Instead, it's precisely because we have obligations to our families, those in our community, and those around the world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 국민국가의 부상으로 사람들이 '국가시민권(state citizenship)'을 다른 정체성에 더하게 됨
det.analysis:
❌ ① global warming(지구 온난화): 정체성과 무관
❌ ② free trade(자유 무역): 문맥 부적절
✅ ③ state citizenship(국가시민권): 국민국가가 부상하며 family·religion 같은 정체성에 '더해진' 것 ←정답
❌ ④ human nature(인간 본성): 'add to other identities'와 어울리지 않음
det.tip: 국민국가 등장 → 가족·종교 등 기존 정체성에 state citizenship(국가시민권)을 더함

det.korean: 우리 정체성에 관한 '단일한 이야기(single story)'는 없다 — 정체성은 여러 겹
det.analysis:
❌ ① final decision(최종 결정): 문맥 부적절
❌ ② common enemy(공동의 적): 문맥 부적절
❌ ③ perfect world(완벽한 세계): 문맥 부적절
✅ ④ single story(단일한 이야기): 세계시민권이 기존 정체성을 대체하지 않고 겹쳐지므로, 정체성에 관한 '하나의 이야기'만 있는 게 아님 ←정답
det.tip: There's not a single story = 단 하나의 이야기만 있는 게 아니다 (정체성은 다층적)
